description: Mapping from generated PDF page index (1..N, 1-indexed) to the reference_scans/page_*.png that is its semantic ground truth, or null if no suitable reference exists. See .factory/library/audit-alignment.md for the full derivation + regeneration procedure.

derivation.notes: At M1-close: ch2+ch3 use chapter-aware 1:1 pinning (opener→opener, ornament→ornament). Ch1 uses positional 1-to-1 (gen 1-7 → ref 105-111) because ch1 has 9 ref pages vs 7 gen pages, AND the M1 ornament is a placeholder '— ∞ —' string that visually doesn't match the winged-cherub glyph on ref 113. Re-derive chapter 1 to fully semantic (pinning gen 7 → ref 113) once M3 replaces the placeholder with the real ornament SVG; the cherub-to-cherub visual match is expected to lift gen-7's score and enable the full chapter-aware mapping without regression.
